regions.notes: UBA's band plan is the IARU Region 1 plan. Reviewed by ON4WX 2026-10-30 (issue #95): 2 m and 70 cm allocations, APRS 144.800, FM calling 145.500, DAPNET 439.9875 and PMR446 confirmed. 433.500 (70 cm FM calling) and 433.400 (FM SSTV) are in the Region 1 430 MHz plan itself; 144.500 is the 2 m image-mode centre in the all-mode (SSB) segment, so this FM radio's SSTV default is 433.400. LPD433: the national plan lists short-range devices at 433.05-434.79 MHz, but the channel plan and voice use are not confirmed for Belgium. No ID interval found in the BIPT 2019 decision; none is inferred (the app's 10-minute reminder is only a reminder).
